outputs: Hotel Highlights (concise one- to two-sentence summaries of accommodation unique selling points)

datasets: English accommodation descriptions and reviews from various accommodation types
outputs: Hotel Highlights are concise, one to two sentences summarising an accommodation's unique selling points, derived from traveller reviews and descriptions.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated dataset descriptions into one canonical form. Normalized model names to standard forms (GPT-3.5 instead of ChatGPT 3.5, PaLM 2 instead of PaLM2). Consolidated output descriptions into a single comprehensive description.
The paper explicitly states that automatic metrics like ROUGE are inadequate for assessing faithfulness and focuses exclusively on human evaluation. No automatic metrics were used.

No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper only mentions LLMs for generation (GPT-3.5 and PaLM 2), and while it mentions future plans to explore LLMs for identifying divergences, this was not implemented in the reported work.

guideline: Participants were shown hotel descriptions and generated highlights, asked to identify divergences (hallucination, contradiction, both, or no divergence) and rate clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality on 7-point Likert scales

Participants were shown a hotel description and a highlight, and asked to specify whether there were any divergences between the two. They could choose if there was a hallucination, a contradiction, both, or no divergence. Then they rated each highlight for clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality on a 7-point Likert scale.
Participants identified hallucinations, contradictions, both, or no divergence, and rated clarity, informativeness, and grammaticality on a 7-point Likert scale.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated redundant guideline descriptions into one canonical description. The criteria list was already comprehensive and correctly extracted.

overall_notes: The extraction quality was generally good. The paper focuses on a practical NLG application (hotel highlight generation) with thorough human evaluation. Key observations: (1) The paper explicitly rejects automatic metrics for their faithfulness evaluation task, (2) Human evaluation was well-designed with multiple criteria and validation tasks, (3) Low inter-annotator agreement was noted as a challenge, (4) Models mentioned were used for generation, not as judges.
